quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q June 2026 quarter revenue mix: mixed-signal microcontrollers $739.1 million (versus $532.6 million a year earlier), analog $410.9 million ($316.2 million) and other $334.7 million ($226.7 million; up 47.6%). quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q supply and capacity: approximately 67% of June-quarter net sales came from products made at outside wafer foundries (64% a year earlier, 65% in fiscal 2026); third-party contractors performed approximately 32% of assembly and 29% of test requirements. Purchase commitments, which primarily consist of agreements for the purchase of goods and services including wafer purchase obligations with its wafer foundries and manufacturing supply capacity reservation commitments, totaled $553.6 million at June 30, 2026, of which $406.3 million falls in fiscal 2027. LTSA customer deposits for assured supply were $333.9 million of $431.0 million deferred revenue. Inventory was $1.05 billion, or 175 days, versus 185 days at March 31, 2026. Capex was $13.9 million ($17.9 million a year earlier) and investments in equipment and facilities over the next 12 months are expected at or below $100.0 million, with most factory expansion still paused through fiscal 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: ~67% of sales from outside foundries; 32% assembly / 29% test outsourced; purchase commitments $553.6 million ($406.3 million in FY2027); LTSA deposits $333.9 million; inventory 175 days; next-12-month capex at or below $100.0 million
